# Apple Support

> > Official support documentation for Apple products and services, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, iTunes, and Apple Account management.

Apple Support provides comprehensive guides, troubleshooting resources, and software documentation for Apple's ecosystem of devices and services. The site covers everything from basic device operations to account management and security features.

## Key Topics

- iPhone
- iPad
- Apple Account
- Troubleshooting
- iOS Features
- App Store
- Apple Gift Card
- Camera App
- QR Code Scanning
- Activation Lock
- iTunes
- Software Downloads
- Control Center
- Device Security

## Device Setup and Security

- [How to remove Activation Lock](https://support.apple.com/en-us/108934): Remove Activation Lock from iPhone and iCloud-linked devices

## Software and Downloads

- [Software Manuals and Downloads](https://support.apple.com/en-us/docs/software): Apple software manuals, specs, and downloads for iTunes, iPhoto, Mac

## iOS and iPadOS Features

- [Scan a QR code with your iPhone or iPad](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102680): Use Camera app or Code Scanner to scan QR codes on iPhone/iPad
- [Create and share photo cutouts on your iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102460): Isolate and share photo subjects using iOS 16 background removal

## Apple Account and Gift Cards

- [Check your gift card balance](https://support.apple.com/en-us/108111): Check Apple Gift Card and App Store balance in Apple Account

## Device Troubleshooting

- [Restart your iPod touch](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102137): Turn iPod touch off and on for troubleshooting
